seo.title: aiMUSIC: original music for businesses
seo.description: Original music profiles and playlists for cafes, restaurants, salons, hotels, fitness studios, and other business spaces.

hero.audience: For cafes, restaurants, salons, hotels, fitness studios, and other business spaces
hero.sub: aiMUSIC creates original music for businesses. Describe your space and receive music shaped around its character, with clear terms of use.
hero.commitment: First we agree the music profile. Before launch, the territory, term, and type of use are recorded in the agreement.
hero.signedBy: aiNOW defines the profile, creates the music, and prepares the documents required for launch.

heroStory.input: A calm cafe by day, warmer and more energetic in the evening.
heroStory.bridge: Mood, tempo, energy, dayparts, and intended use become one approved music brief.
heroStory.productAction: Tracks follow the agreed profile and are arranged into a day-long playlist.
heroStory.result: The owner hears the first sample before the playlist is launched.
heroStory.businessValue: A consistent sound for the space and clear usage terms.

work.headingAccent: From a venue description to a daily playlist.
work.s1Desc: Choose the venue type or briefly describe its atmosphere, guests, and daily rhythm.
work.s2Desc: We agree the genre, tempo, energy, and sound that fit the space.
work.s3Desc: Tracks are created from the agreed music profile instead of copied from a mass catalog.
work.s4Desc: The music follows each daypart: a calm opening, active hours, and a softer evening.
work.s5Desc: The territory, term, type of use, and any exclusivity conditions are recorded in the agreement.
work.s6Desc: When the season, guests, or daily schedule changes, the playlist can be refreshed while keeping one recognizable character.

faq.subtitle: Clear facts about the music, uniqueness, and usage terms.
faq.a1: A custom background-music service for businesses. We turn a venue description into a music profile, create original tracks, and arrange them into a full-day playlist.
faq.q2: Can I play this music in a cafe or restaurant?
faq.a2: Before launch, we agree the territory, term, and type of use, then record them in the customer agreement and track register. The exact documents depend on the venue and jurisdiction.
faq.q3: Will this music be unique to our venue?
faq.a3: The playlist is created from your venue profile instead of copied from a mass catalog. Any exclusivity requirement for specific tracks is stated separately in the agreement.
faq.a4: Yes. We can change the daypart energy, season, mood, and individual tracks while preserving one recognizable character for the space.
faq.a5: Describe the venue and leave a contact number. We clarify the format, prepare a music profile, and create a first illustrative sample for review.

cta.heading: How should your space sound?
cta.subtitle: Leave your number. We will start with a short brief and the first music profile.
cta.phoneNote: We will contact you to clarify the atmosphere and format of the space.

wordmark.heading: What your space receives

wordmark.line: Music that belongs to the atmosphere of your space.
